No, a few bent leaves on arrival are normal and don't count as damage under our Damaged on Arrival policy. Damage means things like snapped main stems, exposed roots, a cracked or smashed pot, or a dead or severely wilted plant.

If you see any of those, report it within **48 hours** of delivery with photos of the plant and the box. After that, any plant problems go through the Plant Care Guarantee (30 days from delivery, or 90 days for Leafy Plus members). It covers significant decline, such as losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse.

If you'd like care tips for a plant that looks stressed, a Plant Care Specialist can help by chat or email at no charge.
